## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any relevant results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Public behavior or configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Database schema changes include an Alembic revision.
- [ ] Collection isolation and the 1,024-dimension invariant are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, internal infrastructure, or proprietary material is included.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test` pass, or limitations are explained above.
